name: Tetyana Paradna
metaDescription: Personal styling, wardrobe edits and personal shopping with stylist Tetyana Paradna. Book a private consultation and define a style that is entirely yours.
tagline: Personal styling for women who want their wardrobe to say what they mean — before they say a word.
portrait: Tetyana Paradna in a long chocolate-brown coat
manifesto: Style is not about clothes. It is about the woman wearing them — how she enters a room, how she is remembered, how she feels when no one is watching. My work is to find that woman, and dress her.
svIntro: Book a single session, or let us shape your image over a whole season. Every collaboration begins with a private conversation.
s1d: A private session to define your personal style, your lifestyle needs and the image you want to project.
s2d: We review what you own, keep what serves you and compose new looks from pieces already in your closet.
s3d: Private appointments in store or online, with a selection prepared for you before you arrive.
s4d: The palette and lines that make you look rested, assured and unmistakably yourself.
s5d: Weddings, stages, interviews, first dates — a look composed for the moment and the photographs after it.
j1d: Your life, your work, your ambitions — and how you want to feel the moment you walk into a room.
j2d: A clear style concept: your colours, silhouettes, references and the words that describe you.
j3d: Your wardrobe reviewed and completed, with a curated selection prepared before every appointment.
j4d: A personal lookbook of outfits and notes — so getting dressed becomes effortless, every day.
pfIntro: Women dressed for the moments that matter to them. Keep scrolling to browse.
quote: [ A client’s words about working with Tetyana — a sentence or two about how it felt to see herself differently. ]
